subject: Stop targeting farmers Premier. Then apologise & Investigate
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government is still targeting farmers, and it needs to stop.

A farmer has just been fined for refusing to let department staff onto his land in the middle of lambing. Anyone who has worked sheep knows what disturbance does to maiden ewes at that time of year. He was fined for protecting his lambs. Unbelievable.

That is your Government, now.

Lily D'Ambrosio resigned. And you have declared war on farmers. The laws she wrote are still in force. The department still answers to you. Jaclyn Symes has picked up exactly where D'Ambrosio left off. The only thing that changed was the name on the door.

So I am asking you for three things, in this order.

Stop targeting farming families. You can give that instruction today.

Apologise to every family your Government has put through it.

Order an independent investigation into how it was allowed to happen, and make the findings public.

The first one costs you nothing and it is the one that matters most, because it is the one still happening.

Yours sincerely,

subject: You inherited this, Premier. Now stop it.
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government is still targeting farmers, and it needs to stop.

You have declared war on Aussie farmers and it needs to STOP!

A farmer has been fined for refusing department staff entry to his property during lambing. Farming families across this state have had government staff arrive at their gates without warning or invitation. An elderly farmer had security standing there while she was pressed about accepting transmission lines on her land. And when Greg Baldwin rang triple zero to report trespassers on his own property, he was the one who ended up charged.

On 27 April 2026 the Director of Public Prosecutions withdrew every single charge against him. Not some of them. All of them. No explanation given, then or since.

D'Ambrosio's resignation did not fix any of that, and you have not changed the behaviour.

Stop it. That is the first thing and it is entirely within your power.

Then apologise to the farming families your Government went after, and order an independent investigation into the targeting of farmers with the findings made public. Make sure this never happens again.

That is the minimum, Premier, and it is well overdue.

Yours sincerely,

subject: IT'S TIME YOU STOP TARGETING FARMERS PREMIER!
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government is targeting farmers, and it needs to stop.

I would like you to explain something to me.

A farmer has been fined for refusing to let your department's staff onto his land during lambing. Not for obstructing a road. Not for hurting anybody. For saying no to strangers walking through his ewes at the worst possible time of year.

What exactly was the public good served by that fine?

And it is not one bad day. Farms across this state have had people turn up unannounced who were never invited on. A farmer in her eighties was pressed about VNI West with a security escort in her home.

A Minister has resigned since. Jaclyn Symes has the portfolio now, and the conduct has not changed by one inch.

So I am asking you, as Premier. Stop it. Then apologise to every farming family your Government has targeted, and order an independent investigation into how it happened, with the findings made public.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Stop your Government targeting farmers.
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

You have declared war on farmers.

Your Government is targeting farmers, and it needs to stop.

We were told a resignation would draw a line under this. It did not.

Since Lily D'Ambrosio left, a farmer has been fined for refusing department staff access to his property during lambing. That is not a leftover from the old regime. That is your Government, under your new Energy Minister, doing the same thing to the same people.

I do not want another media statement. I do not want a review conducted by the department that did it.

Stop targeting farmers first. Then apologise to the families involved. Then order an independent investigation and put what it finds in front of the public.

Somebody is still signing off on these decisions, Premier. Farming families are entitled to know who, and why, and they are entitled to have it stop while you find out.

Yours sincerely,

subject: These families need it to stop, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government is targeting farmers, and it needs to stop.

There are farming families in this state who have not slept properly because of what your Government has done to them, and it is still going on.

People turned up at their HOMES uninvited. A farmer was charged for ringing triple zero on his own land, and then watched every charge quietly withdrawn without a word of explanation. And now a farmer has been fined for refusing entry during a critical stage of farming.

Not one of them has received an apology. More to the point, not one of them has been told it will stop.

Only you can give that instruction.

Stop targeting farming families. Apologise to every family your Government has put through it. Order an independent investigation into how it was allowed to happen, with the findings made public, so this never happens again.

It costs you nothing to do the decent thing here, Premier.

Yours sincerely,

subject: He rang triple zero. He got charged.
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government is targeting farmers, and it needs to stop.

Greg Baldwin rang triple zero to report trespassers on his own property. He was the one who ended up charged.

On 27 April 2026 the Director of Public Prosecutions withdrew every single charge against him. Not reduced. Not settled. Withdrawn in full, without one word of explanation to him or to anybody else.

His family carried those charges for months. Nobody has said sorry. Nobody has acknowledged that anything went wrong.

And it has not stopped. A farmer has since been fined for refusing to let department staff onto his land during lambing, under a new Energy Minister, with the same department, on your watch.

Premier, stop it. Then apologise to the families your Government has targeted, and order an independent investigation into how it happened with the findings made public. Make sure this never happens again.

Start with a phone call to the Baldwins.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Generations on this land. Then your government declared war.
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government is targeting farmers, and it needs to stop.

Farming families have worked this country for generations - some of them seven or eight. They have dealt with drought, fire, bad markets and worse seasons. What they did not expect was their own government turning up and betraying them.

That is what has happened across this state. Unannounced visits to properties that never asked anyone on. A farmer charged after ringing triple zero on his own land, with every charge withdrawn on 27 April 2026 and no reason ever given. And now a fine for a farmer who would not let department staff in during lambing. He was fined for trying to protect his lambs during a critical farming period. This is a joke.

One Minister has gone. Jaclyn Symes holds the portfolio now and the families are still waiting - not just for an apology, but for it to stop.

Stop it, Premier. Then apologise to the farmers you've targeted. Then order an independent investigation into how a government came to treat its own farmers this way, and make the findings public.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Your silence will not save you, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government is targeting farmers, and it needs to stop.

Every day you say nothing about this, the harder it is to argue this is not deliberate.

We will not stop until you have stopped targeting farmers and apologised.

Farming families had government staff arrive at their properties without invitation. An elderly farmer was pressed about VNI West with a security escort in her home. A farmer who rang triple zero to report trespassers was charged, and every charge against him was withdrawn on 27 April 2026 without explanation. A farmer has now been fined for refusing entry during lambing - a CRITICAL farming period.

Your Government has not stopped any of it. It has not apologised for any of it. It has not explained any of it.

Your silence is an admission, Premier, and the position it reads as is that the targeting of farmers is fine.

None of this is fine.

Stop targeting farming families. Apologise to the ones you have already put through it. Order an independent investigation with the findings made public.

Three things. None of them is hard.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Farmers think twice about calling the police now
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government is targeting farmers, and it needs to stop.

Here is the damage that will outlast every one of us.

Greg Baldwin rang triple zero to report trespassers on his own land and he was the one charged. Every charge was withdrawn on 27 April 2026 without a word of explanation.

Farmers watched that happen. Now there are people who will not ring for help when strangers turn up on their property, because they saw what it cost the last bloke who did. And when a farmer is fined for refusing department staff entry during lambing, that lesson gets taught all over again.

Your government has now declared a war on farming.

That is a serious trust to have broken, and your Government is still breaking it.

Stop it, Premier. Apologise to the families involved. Order an independent investigation with the findings made public, so that this never happens again.

Until you do, that fear stays exactly where your Government put it. And we will hold you to account!

Yours sincerely,

subject: Three things, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government has declared war on farmers, and it needs to stop.

I will keep this short.

Government staff turned up unannounced at farms across this state that never invited them. Security was brought along to press a farmer in her eighties about VNI West. Greg Baldwin rang triple zero on his own property and was the one charged, and every charge was withdrawn on 27 April 2026 without explanation. And a farmer has now been fined for refusing department staff entry during lambing.

A Minister has resigned. That is not justice, it is not an apology, and it plainly is not the end of it.

Three things, Premier.

Stop targeting farming families.

Apologise to every family your Government has put through it.

Order an independent investigation into how it was allowed to happen, and make the findings public.

I will keep asking until all three are done.

Yours sincerely,
